The '''''Imperator''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to transfer accepted cadets to the military training academy on [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
